_: It.25: a CONVERSATIONAL NPC with a multi-option dialogue menu, building on It.23. One Start-Game-Enabled host quest carries THREE top-level player topics (each its own DialogBranch{TopLevel}), so activating the NPC shows three menu choices — lore, a joke, a farewell — each with multi-line responses and a distinct EMOTION (new this iteration: per-topic `emotion` + `emotionValue`, previously hardcoded Neutral). All three INFOs are GetIsID-gated to this NPC. Subtitles ON to read the lines. `coc RiverwoodSleepingGiantInn`, activate Brom, and the menu should list all three prompts; each can be picked and returns you to the menu (repeatable).

npcs.name: Brom the Storyteller
npcs.greeting: Pull up a chair, friend. What would you like to hear?

quests._: Single host quest for all three topics. startGameEnabled (default) so it runs.
quests.name: ModForge Conversation

dialogue.prompt: What's the history of this inn?
responses: The Sleeping Giant has stood here longer than any of us remember.
Walls like these have heard a thousand secrets — and kept every one.
Why did the dragon cross the Pale? To get to the OTHER shout!
Ha! I'll be here all week, friend.
Off already? The road's a lonely thing.
Walk with the warmth of the hearth at your back, traveler.
